claim: Adventdalen aeolian silt cover and syngenetic ground ice coexist and grew together
direct_evidence: CS-1 cores: OSL ages every 2 cm; gravimetric ice 20-50% (to 155 cm), 60-80% (155-188 cm), up to 250% near base; mainly syngenetic cryostructures; ice content falls upward as sedimentation rises
site_year_depth_of_direct_evidence: CS-1 78.201N15.840E; cores September2019; 0-3.2m; August2022 exposure20mNE separately located
independent_truth_for_the_claim: yes at CS-1 (gravimetric ice, cryostructure logs)
alternative_explanations_or_caveats: Authors: epigenetic ice/cryoturbation below ~275-295 cm and age inversions; reworking in 10-55 cm; dosimetric effects of high ice content

claim: Loess accumulation reached 0.35 cm/yr and ~2900 g m-2 yr-1
direct_evidence: Body text: >0.3 cm/yr and dMAR ~2900 g m-2 yr-1 in c. 750-900 a; ~0.25 cm/yr (~2000) in 1900-2450 a; <=0.15 cm/yr below the active layer; ~0.05 cm/yr (~400) in 2700-3000 a
independent_truth_for_the_claim: no independent accumulation measurement; age model from OSL
alternative_explanations_or_caveats: Authors call dMAR 'broad estimates' (density from 7 samples); 0.35 not found in body text read; two non-exclusive drivers (wind vs glaciofluvial supply); local river-bar source
status: 部分支持 (峰值期，非長期平均)

claim_origin: 原作者引用 (Rotem) / 另一組實測 (Rasmussen, UNISCALM)
direct_evidence: Rotem: 'commonly 60-100 cm' (cited). Rasmussen: 98 cm at CS-1, said to match CALM. UNISCALM: <1 m first six years (min 74 cm, 2005), >=1 m since 2006
site_year_depth_of_direct_evidence: three different places/periods (ADE cited; CS-1; CALM grid location unknown)
independent_truth_for_the_claim: probing/monitoring at CS-1 and CALM; none at ADE in the text read
alternative_explanations_or_caveats: Increasing trend means older 60-100 cm values may not describe 2022 conditions; interannual variability large (abstract)
status: 數量級一致，非同址同年

claim: ADE borehole characterises permafrost under the valley floor
direct_evidence: Two cores (13 m, 9 m), March 2017: syngenetic 1.0-5.5 m, epigenetic below; chloride interface 9-11 m
independent_truth_for_the_claim: borehole itself is the data; no radar, no co-located core
alternative_explanations_or_caveats: Chemistry may reflect sediment dissolution or ion exchange (authors); cryopegs/brine possible
status: 支持 (ADE 結構；與 CS-1 相距 ~6.0 km，與雷達無關)

claim: The ~1.5 m polygon-trough radar reflector is ice (ice wedge) under an active layer
direct_evidence: WISDOM radargrams, 3 reflections ~1.5 m; FDTD trough model with/without ice wedge; middle reflection 'cannot be explained without' an ice wedge
independent_truth_for_the_claim: none stated for the polygon troughs (stated 3D ground truth is for a glacier ice cave)
alternative_explanations_or_caveats: Same abstract: snow/trough-interface reflections weaken on steep slopes; cave returns may be multiple reflections. Other hypotheses (this team, not authors'): ice-rich vs ice-poor sediment contrast (CS-1 ice content varies 20-250% with depth), frozen/thawed or lithologic boundary, antenna-ground coupling (Plettemeier 2025); CPR alone is not diagnostic of water ice (Harrar 2025, simulation)
status: 作者結論；無獨立冰真值

claim: ε=3.2 (ice) and ε>=7 (active layer) were measured at Adventdalen
claim_origin: 本隊待查假設 (abstract wording is ambiguous)
direct_evidence: Abstract lists the values as model inputs; how they were obtained is not stated
alternative_explanations_or_caveats: Treat as assumed model parameters until the full paper shows a measurement or calibration

claim: Core, borehole and radar results are one coherent Adventdalen site
direct_evidence: CS-1 and ADE are ~5.97km apart; WISDOM polygon lines have no coordinates; dates differ (CS-1 Sep2019, ADE Mar2017, WISDOM Mar2022). ADE lies ~1.1km south of the cited polygon-site bounding box. Same valley is not a co-located chain.
alternative_explanations_or_caveats: Same valley name is not the same site; shared depth range 0-3 m is the only overlap

claim: MS-02 column dust optical depth can stand in for ground cover accumulation
direct_evidence: MS-02 CDOD: 9.3 µm absorption column opacity, 3° grid, dimensionless (MY34 p95 0.240, MY35 p95 0.173). CS-1 dMAR: mass per area per year from a dated core
alternative_explanations_or_caveats: No conversion from column opacity to surface deposition without wind, particle size and source data

claim: Adventdalen results show ice can be detected beneath an aeolian cover at MS-02
direct_evidence: No single Adventdalen place combines dated aeolian cover, measured ice, and radar detection in the sources read; SWIM values at MS-02 are consistency, not abundance
alternative_explanations_or_caveats: MS-02 cover thickness, ice depth, and permittivity are unknown
